blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Individualized attribution estimates which functional networks drive a model prediction for a given subject and is often proposed as an interpretable resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) biomarker, but its test-retest reliability is rarely quantified. We evaluate per-subject network-ablation attribution for a frozen resting-state functional connectivity (FC) predictor (Schaefer-200 FC predicting MMSE/ADAS-Cog13) trained on N=875 subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), using, and (iii) a subject-level permutation null. Split-half reliability is near-ceiling (Spearman p=0.948/0.950) but drops on scan-rescan (p=0.609/0.616). Under the mismatched-subject null, correlations remain substantial (p~0.46-0.47), indicating strong population-shared structure, yet matched pairs exceed this null (z~6.6-6.9, p<=10-4). Thus, in ADNI, individualized network attribution contains a modest but non-zero person-specific component atop a strong population-shared pattern. We recommend reporting scan-rescan reliability together with a permutation-null control, rather than within-session proxies alone, to avoid overstating individual specificity.
blocks.zh: 功能网络驱动特定对象模型预测的个性化归属估计,常被提出作为可解释的休眠状态fMRI(rs-fMRI)生物标志,但其测试-再测试可靠性很少量化. 我们利用阿尔茨海默病神经成像倡议(ADNI)的N=875科目,对冻结休养状态功能连接(FC)预测器(Schaefer-200 FC预测MMSE/ADAS-Cog13)进行每个主题的网络集成归属进行评估,并(三)一个主题层面的表征无效。 平分半可靠性为近高(Spearman p=0.948/0.9.50),但在扫描-rescan上下降(p=0.609/0.616). 在不匹配主体无效的情况下,关联性仍然很大(p~0.46-0.47),表明人口共享结构很强,但匹配对数却超过了这个无效(z~6.6-6.9,p~10-4). 因此,在ADNI中,个性化的网络归属包含一个适度但非零人特有成分,不具有强大的人口共享模式. 我们建议报告扫描的可靠性,同时进行演化-核控制,而不是仅仅在会内进行代用,以避免夸大个人的特异性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Models that map resting-state functional connectivity (FC) to cognition and clinical phenotypes are increasingly used in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) neuroimaging [ 4 , 16 ] . Beyond group-level accuracy, a common objective is individualized attribution : for a given subject, estimating which functional networks drive that subject’s prediction. Such per-subject attribution is only meaningful if it is reproducible.
blocks.zh: 在阿尔茨海默氏病(AD)神经成像[4,16]中,越来越多地使用将休眠状态功能连接(FC)映射为认知和临床苯基的模型. 除了群体层面的准确性外,一个共同目标是个性化的归属:对于一个特定主体,估计哪个功能网络驱动该主体的预测. 这种每个主体的归属只有在可复制的情况下才有意义。

blocks.en:
Reliability is a central constraint. Large-scale analyses suggest that stable brain–behavior effects often require much larger samples than historically used [ 11 ] , and FC test–retest reliability is frequently modest (pooled mean edge-level Intraclass Correlation Coefficient, ICC ≈ 0.29 \approx 0.29 ) [ 13 ] .
The ICC describes how reproducibly a single connectivity edge is measured. Prior work on subject-specific parcellations reports reproducibility across short-interval repeat sessions [ 17 , 10 ] , but does not quantify test–retest reliability of model-derived attribution signatures over the multi-year intervals typical of aging cohorts.

blocks.en:
An additional aspect is attribution stability : feature-importance maps can
vary substantially under resampling, noise, and other perturbations even when
predictive accuracy is similar [ 1 , 7 ] . In
FC prediction, however, attribution work has largely emphasized group-averaged
importance. For connectomes rather than attributions, differential
identifiability formalizes the person-specific, test–retest-identifiable
component [ 2 ] , and permutation-null models are
standard for separating population-shared from person-specific
structure [ 5 , 12 ] . Neither has been
applied to per-subject attribution signatures. To the best of our knowledge, no prior work
combines per-subject attribution of an FC-based cognitive predictor with a
quantitative test–retest evaluation on independent repeat scans of the same
individuals.

blocks.en:
We address this gap using a frozen FC-based multilayer perceptron (FC-MLP) trained to jointly predict MMSE and ADAS-Cog13 from Schaefer-200 FC on N = 875 N{=}875 ADNI subjects (Sect. 2 ). Instead of edge-level ICC, we assess test–retest consistency of each subject’s network-attribution ranking. We compute per-subject network-ablation signatures and evaluate reproducibility with three checks: within-session split-half, scan–rescan across independent repeat visits, and a cluster-aware subject-level permutation null.
The main contributions in this study are: 1. Quantify how split-half overestimates scan–rescan reliability of per-subject network attribution (74 subjects; 205 session pairs). 2. Use a subject-level permutation null to estimate the mismatched-subject baseline and the residual person-specific component. 3. Provide reporting recommendations to avoid overstating individual specificity.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental details
blocks.zh: 3 实验细节

blocks.en: 3.1 Data description
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据说明

blocks.en:
ADNI is a multi-site, longitudinal study of aging and Alzheimer’s disease with multimodal neuroimaging [ 9 ] . We analyzed data from N = 875 N{=}875 unique ADNI participants who had both T1-weighted MRI and rs-fMRI scans. Within the N = 875 N{=}875 cohort, diagnoses are CN ( n = 464 n{=}464 ), MCI ( n = 315 n{=}315 ), Dementia ( n = 94 n{=}94 ), and unknown ( n = 2 n{=}2 ). Age is 72.6 ± 7.9 72.6\pm 7.9 years (range 50–97); 489 subjects are female and 386 male. Subjects were enrolled in ADNI1 ( n = 37 n{=}37 ), ADNI-GO ( n = 38 n{=}38 ), ADNI2 ( n = 256 n{=}256 ), ADNI3 ( n = 474 n{=}474 ), and ADNI4 ( n = 68 n{=}68 ); 2 unknown. rs-fMRI scans were acquired at 3.0 T across 53 sites with heterogeneous protocols (TR 0.607–6.02 s; 96–972 volumes after removal of initial volumes).
For the upstream prediction model, the cohort is split once at the subject level into fixed train/validation/test partitions of 611/132/132 stratified by diagnosis. We evaluate attribution and reliability only on the held-out 132-subject test split; scan–rescan further restricts to test subjects with repeat-visit rs-fMRI.

ADNI1(n = 37 n{=}37),ADNI-GO(n = 38 n{=}38),ADNI2(n = 256 n{=}256),ADNI3(n = 474 n{=}474),ADNI4(n = 68 n{=}68),2种未知. rs-fMRI扫描器在53个站点的3.0T处获得,具有多种协议(TR 0.607–6.02 s;删除初始卷后96–972卷).
就上游预测模型而言,该组别在主体一级被拆分为611/132/132分级的固定列车/验证/测试分区。 我们只评估被搁置的132主体测试拆分的归属和可靠性;扫描-rescan进一步限制测试重访rs-fMRI的主体.

blocks.en: 3.2 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 3.2 详细执行情况

blocks.en: We analyze a trained FC-MLP and keep its weights fixed for all attribution and reliability analyses.
blocks.zh: 我们分析一个训练有素的FC-MLP,并将它的权重固定在所有的归属和可靠性分析上.

blocks.en: rs-fMRI preprocessing includes motion correction, HD-BET brain extraction [ 8 ] , rigid rs-fMRI → \to T1 registration, detrending, and nuisance regression of mean white-matter (WM) and cerebrospinal-fluid (CSF) signals plus 5 anatomical CompCor (aCompCor) components [ 3 ] from a combined WM/CSF mask, without global signal regression. Time series are band-pass filtered (0.01–0.1 Hz, using each subject’s TR), z z -scored, and scrubbed at framewise displacement (FD) > 0.5 >0.5 mm after filtering; FD was computed from translation magnitude only rather than the full six-parameter formulation [ 14 ] , as rotation parameters were not retained upstream. No spatial smoothing or slice-timing correction is applied. We compute Schaefer-200 [ 15 ] FC as a Fisher- z z transformed 200 × 200 200\times 200 Pearson correlation matrix and vectorize the upper triangle (19,900 edges). An edge-coverage mask is concatenated, yielding a 39,800-dimensional input.
blocks.zh: rs-fMRI预处理包括运动校正,HD-BET脑提取[8],刚性rs-fMRI →\to T1注册,调试,以及平均白物质(WM)和脑积水(CSF)信号的扰动回归,加上5个解剖复合体(ACompCor)组件[3]从WM/CSF的组合罩中,没有全球信号回归. 时间序列经过过滤(0.01-0.1) Hz, 使用每个主题的TR),z - 分数,并在过滤后在帧移位(FD) > 0.5 > 0.5毫米处擦除; FD只从翻译量计算,而不是全部六参数配方[14],因为旋转参数没有保留上游. 不采用空间平滑或切片刻度修正。 我们计算Schaefer-200 [15] FC作为Fisher-z z的变形200×200\times 200 Pearson相关矩阵并矢量上三角形(19,900边). 边缘覆盖面罩被凝固,产生39,800维的输入.

blocks.en: The FC-MLP encoder maps 39,800 → 256 → 128 39{,}800\to 256\to 128 with LayerNorm/GELU/dropout (0.3), and the decoder maps 128 → 64 → 2 128\to 64\to 2 with GELU/dropout (0.3). The model is trained with Huber loss ( δ = 1.0 \delta{=}1.0 ) using Adam ( lr = 10 − 4 \mathrm{lr}=10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 5 10^{-5} ; no schedule/warmup), batch size 16, and up to 100 epochs. Early stopping uses patience 15 on validation loss; we keep the single best checkpoint (lowest validation loss). During training only, an augmentation zeros 5 randomly chosen parcels per sample. Targets are z z -scored on train only and inverse-transformed for reporting. Three independent runs with different random initializations share the same fixed split. ComBat harmonization [ 6 ] uses the TR group as batch variable (a proxy for acquisition protocol) and protects diagnosis, whose composition differs across TR groups ( χ 2 = 35.66 \chi^{2}{=}35.66 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ); no other covariates are included. It is fit on the training split only, never refit, and applied to validation/test subjects and split-half halves, but not to repeat-visit sessions (both sides of scan–rescan use pre-ComBat features).
blocks.zh: FC-MLP编码器的地图为39,800 ~ 256 ~ 128 39{,}800\to 256\to 128,与LayerNorm/GELU/dropout(0.3),解码器的地图为128 ~ 64\}2 128\to 64\to 2,与GELU/dropout(0.3). 该型号的训练为Huber损失(δ=1.0\delta{=}1.0),使用Adam(lr = 10− 4\mathrm{lr}=10^{-4},重量衰减10− 5 10^{-5};无调度/保温),批号16,最高100个纪元. 早期停止在验证损失时使用耐心15;我们保留单一的最佳检查点(最低验证损失). 仅在培训期间,一个扩增的零是每个样本随机选择的5个包裹。 目标为z z - 只在火车上得分,反向转换用于报告. 3个独立运行,不同随机初始化,共享相同的固定拆分. ComBat协调[6]将TR组作为批量变量(获取协议的代名词),并保护诊断,诊断组的组成因TR组而异( 2 = 35.66\chi^{2}{=}35.66,p < 0.001 p<0.001]);不包括其他共变物. 它只适合训练分裂,从不翻新,并应用于验证/测试科目和半分半分,但不用于重复访问课程(扫描-rescan两侧都使用前ComBat特性).

blocks.en: 3.3 Results
blocks.zh: 3.3 结果

blocks.en: The frozen predictor is weak: on the n = 113 n{=}113 test subjects with both targets, R 2 = 0.053 ± 0.034 R^{2}{=}0.053\pm 0.034 for MMSE and 0.087 ± 0.037 0.087\pm 0.037 for ADAS-Cog13 (mean ± \pm SD over runs). As a diagnostic check, the predicted ADAS-Cog13 score separates CN from Dementia with AUC 0.780 0.780 (95 % bootstrap CI 0.611–0.911; n = 72 n=72 of the 113 subjects with both targets: 58 CN, 14 Dementia).
blocks.zh: 冷冻预测器弱:在 n = 113 n = 113 测试对象上,两个目标R 2 = 0.053 ± 0.034 R^{2}{=}0.053\pm 0.034为MMSE,0.087±0.037 0.087\pm 0.037为ADAS-Cog13(平均±\pm SD超运行). 作为诊断检查,预测的ADAS-Cog13分数以AUC 0.780 0.780(95%的靴子CI 0.611-0.911;n = 72n=72)将CN与Demmentia区分开来,这两个标的分别为:58 CN,14 Dementia.

blocks.en: Within-session split-half reliability is near-ceiling for both targets (mean ρ = 0.948 \rho{=}0.948 / 0.950 0.950 , median ≈ 0.99 \approx 0.99 ; Tab. 1 ). On independent repeat visits (205 session pairs from 74 subjects), subject-level scan–rescan reliability drops to ρ = 0.609 \rho{=}0.609 (MMSE) and 0.616 0.616 (ADAS-Cog13), with large between-subject variation (10th–90th percentiles 0.34 0.34 – 0.90 0.90 and 0.33 0.33 – 0.85 0.85 ). Pair-pooled means are slightly lower ( 0.593 0.593 / 0.588 0.588 ) because subjects with more follow-ups receive more weight. Restricted to the same 74 subjects, split-half reliability is 0.933 0.933 / 0.939 0.939 , a paired difference of 0.324 0.324 / 0.323 0.323 (Wilcoxon p < 10 − 12 p<10^{-12} ), indicating that split-half substantially overestimates test–retest reliability.

Under the subject-level permutation null, mismatched subjects still correlate strongly ( ρ = 0.463 \rho{=}0.463 / 0.472 0.472 ), but the matched statistic exceeds the null ( z = 6.89 z{=}6.89 / 6.63 6.63 ; p ≤ 10 − 4 p\leq 10^{-4} ), corresponding to a modest person-specific excess of ≈ 0.15 \approx 0.15 (MMSE) and ≈ 0.14 \approx 0.14 (ADAS-Cog13).

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Per-subject attribution reliability depends strongly on protocol: split-half is near-ceiling ( ρ ≈ 0.95 \rho{\approx}0.95 ), but drops on scan–rescan across independent repeat visits ( ρ ≈ 0.61 \rho{\approx}0.61 – 0.62 0.62 ), consistent with additional between-visit variability beyond within-session sampling noise. The permutation null suggests that much of this structure is population-shared, with only a modest person-specific excess; robustness to other cohorts, preprocessing, parcellations, attribution operators, and models remains untested.
blocks.zh: 每个主体的归属可靠性在很大程度上取决于协议: 拆分半是接近上限( ^ 0. 95\rho\ 近似 0. 95) , 但是在扫描上下降 – rescan 跨越独立的重复访问( ^ 0. 61\rho\ 近似 0. 61– 0. 62 0. 62) , 与会内采样噪音以外的额外访问间差异一致. 排版无效表明,这种结构大部分是人口共享的,只有适度的人特有过剩;对其他组群的坚固性,预处理,包裹,归属操作员和模型仍然没有经过测试.

blocks.en: The coexistence of shared and person-specific structure mirrors FC itself, where connectomes are identifiable across sessions [ 5 , 2 ] yet test–retest reliability is modest [ 13 ] . The strong shared profile likely has two sources. First, the ablations overlap by construction: every between-network edge ( i , j ) (i,j) with i ∈ n i\in n , j ∈ m j\in m is zeroed in both x ∖ n x_{\setminus n} and x ∖ m x_{\setminus m} , coupling I n ( t ) I^{(t)}_{n} and I m ( t ) I^{(t)}_{m} ; within-network-only ablation would remove this overlap. Second, the weak predictor may respond mainly to group-level FC structure. Because ρ \rho is bounded above, a high shared baseline leaves little room for an individual excess, so the person-specific component may be underestimated.
blocks.zh: 共享结构与个人特异性结构的共存反射了FC本身,其中连接体在会话[5,2]中可以识别,然而测试-测试可靠性却不大[13]. 强有力的共享简介可能有两个来源。 首先,通过构造的线条重叠:每个网间边缘(i, j) (i, j) 与 i 的 n i\ in n, j 的 j m\ m 的线条在 x 的 n 和 x 的 setminus n} 和 x 的 m 的 setminus m} 中都是零; 将 I n (t) 的 i 和 I m (t) 的 i 的 i \ (t) ; 仅网络内部的 explation 将消除这种重叠 。 其二,弱预测器可能主要响应组位FC结构. 由于 $\rho 的边界在以上,高共享基线为个人的过量留下的空间很小,因此特定个人的成分可能被低估.

blocks.en: Limitations include the modest repeat-visit sample (74 subjects; 205 session pairs) and the weak, run-variable predictor (Sect. 3 ). Repeat-visit sessions were not ComBat-harmonized, so part of the split-half to scan–rescan gap may reflect this mismatch. Inter-visit intervals are long and variable (median 24.4 months, IQR 12.2–48.4) and are not modeled.
blocks.zh: 限制包括适度的重复访问样本(74个课题;205个会话对)和弱小的,可变的预测器(第3节. 重复访问的会话没有实现ComBat协调,因此部分拆分到扫描-rescan间隙可能会反映出这种不匹配. 互访间隔长且可变(中间为24.4个月,IQR 12.2-48.4),没有建模.

blocks.en: We therefore recommend treating within-session proxies as expected upper bounds, reporting scan–rescan estimates when repeat visits exist, and including a permutation-null (or equivalent) control; these recommendations should be validated in further aging/AD cohorts such as OASIS-3 and AIBL. In summary, per-subject network attributions are far less reproducible across visits than within-session estimates suggest, and most of their apparent stability reflects a pattern shared across the cohort, so individual specificity should be demonstrated against an explicit population baseline before attributions are interpreted as personal biomarkers.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们建议把会期内代用作为预期的上限,在重复访问时报告扫描估计,并包括一个固定数(或等效的)控制;这些建议应在进一步老龄化/艾滋病组别,如OASIS-3和AIBL中加以验证。 简言之,每个主题网络的归属比会期内估计显示的要少得多,其表面稳定性大多反映了整个组别共享的模式,因此,在归属被解释为个人生物标志之前,应参照明确的人口基线来表明个人的特征。
